prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1143; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a motor vehicle collision that occurred when your insured's vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client sustained injuries as a result of this collision and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has already been in contact with our client, please let us know so that we can address it.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured, along with a copy of the declarations page and confirmation of any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, telematics information, repair estimates, and any surveillance or dash camera footage in your possession or control.
